exact_statement: For every finite Boolean gate h and arbitrary disjoint finite Boolean inner functions g_j on uniform physical bits, including constants and dummies, let F=h(g_1,...,g_r), q_j be the true outer pivotal probabilities and C=H(F)-sum_j q_j H(g_j), entropy in bits. For each physical query i in core j, mean C(F|i=b)-C(F)<= (4/ln2)*Inf_i(F)<=6*Inf_i(F), with strict second inequality when Inf_i(F)>0. This follows from the exact identity mean C_child-C_parent=q_j[Phi((E g_j)^2,ghat_j({i})^2)+J_i(g_j)]-B_special-J_i(F), where Phi(A,B)=(A+B)log2(A+B)-Alog2 A-Blog2 B, B_special>=0 and J is Jensen-Shannon divergence of the two restriction Fourier laws. For every K>=0, let rho_j be each core full stopping hull of (H-KI)_+. For kappa=4/ln2 or6, the signed potential A_K=C+kappa I(F)+sum_j q_j rho_j is nonnegative, full-query superharmonic and majorizes (H(F)-K I(F))_+. With the original partition fixed, admissions do not change this full-universe potential. Any ALREADY SUPPLIED credit at least A_K can be propagated with conserved conditional mean, preserving every old nonnegative credit owner and signed debit label, both full children and spent outside donors. No dimension-independent initial bound A_K<=L I is asserted; singleton physical cores yield A_K=H(F)+kappa I(F), retaining the universal FEI initial-payment gap.
